name: auth-7
title: Set New Password With Rules
description: Reset-password card with new and confirm fields plus live requirement checks for length, uppercase, number, and match, ending in a success state.

standards.purpose: Let a locked-out user set a new password under rules they can see while typing.
useWhen: The user arrived from a valid, unexpired reset link.
doNotUseWhen: The reset token is missing or expired — show a recovery path instead.

rules.check: The surface states that reset links expire and are single-use.
Every requirement is shown and validated inline before submit.
New-password fields declare autocomplete=new-password so managers offer to save.
